newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kolbenschmidt-no sense in T&N exercising option.
newsitem.headline: Kolbenschmidt-no sense in T&N exercising option.

text.p: Germany's Kolbenschmidt AG said on Wednesday it no longer made sense for Britain's T&N Plc to exercise its options to buy a stake in it.
"The waiting game with T&N is over," a spokesman for Kolbenschmidt said in response to a Reuter enquiry.

Earlier, German defence and engineering group Rheinmetall AG said it had an agreement to take over a 24.99 percent stake in Kolbenschmidt from Commerzbank AG and would be seeking to secure a majority stake in Kolbenschmidt this year.
T&N has options on a similar-sized stake which is parked with institutional investors and once also belonged to Commerzbank AG.
The German cartel office has opposed earlier attempts by T&N to gain control in Kolbenschmidt.
